description: Histogram of a numeric field (kwp, surface, tilt, azimuth, n_vintages, first_seen, last_seen) with exact counts per bin, for France or one département. Answers "how are installations distributed by size / tilt / orientation / year?". kwp, surface, tilt and azimuth are model estimates. first_seen/last_seen are imagery years, not installation dates. Data quality note: this is a detection dataset, not an exhaustive inventory (estimated recall ~0.6). A missing detection does not mean no PV installation exists there. kwp, surface, tilt and azimuth are model estimates, not surveyed values. In this server, quality_filter=true keeps only detections identified by 2 or more sources (see source_encoding in get_data_quality_reference). Call get_data_quality_reference for the full picture before assessing fitness for a specific use case.

bin_edges.description: Custom ascending bin edges; each bin is [edge_i, edge_i+1) and the last is closed. Ignored for first_seen / last_seen, which are counted per year (use min_year / max_year).

dpt.description: French département code. Omit for all of France.

max_year.description: For first_seen / last_seen: last year to count.

min_year.description: For first_seen / last_seen: first year to count.

quality_filter.description: If true, restrict to detections identified by 2+ sources.

name: get_field_distribution
